result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use to affiliates and contractors and deletes at-will revocability, but it does not clearly achieve the required successor transfer right because the licence remains expressly “non-transferable, non-assignable” while the new parenthetical says it is transferable in specified transactions. That internal contradiction should be resolved with an express exception. For a subscription licence, the operative language also does not state that termination is permitted only for an uncured material breach; the margin comment cannot cure that omission. The edits otherwise remain targeted and preserve the clause’s unrelated commercial scope.
